title: libpod: fix idmap=true/false mount option parsing
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

#### Checklist

Ensure you have completed the following checklist for your pull request to be reviewed:
<!-- Use [x] to mark as done, or click the checkbox after opening PR -->

- [x] I have read and understood our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and will not have more than two open PRs as a new contributor.
- [x] PR description, commit message, and GitHub comments are human-written, per [LLM Policy](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/community/blob/main/LLM_POLICY.md)
- [x] Certify you wrote the patch or otherwise have the right to pass it on as an open-source patch by signing all
commits. (`git commit -s`). (If needed, use `git commit -s --amend`).  The author email must match
the sign-off email address. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-your-prs)
for more information.
- [x] Referenced issues using `Fixes: #00000` in commit message (if applicable)
- [x] [Tests](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/tree/main/test#readme) have been added/updated (or no tests are needed)
- [x] [Documentation](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/main/docs/README.md) has been updated (or no documentation changes are needed)
- [x] All commits pass `make validatepr` (format/lint checks)
- [x] [Release note](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/guide/release-notes.md) entered in the section below (or `None` if no user-facing changes)

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

The documentation for --mount and --volume states that idmap accepts
a boolean value (true or false), but using idmap=true or idmap=false
fails with:

  Error: unknown option "true"

Only the bare `idmap` form works. This is inconsistent with what
the docs say.

This PR fixes parseIDMapMountOption to accept boolean values:
- idmap=true  is now treated the same as bare idmap
- idmap=false cleanly disables idmapping

I also added a nil check in the rootfs idmap path so it is skipped
when idmap=false is used, and updated the docs for --mount and
--volume to reflect the valid syntax.

Fixes: #24249

comments.body: Hmm, I don't think the maintainers would want these kinds of changes. Since #29129, idmap's behavior matches the doc, and #24249 is still open because of the coverage table idea.

@jiwahn 
Thanks for the context! I wasn't aware that #29129 had already addressed the doc mismatch. I'll close this PR. Should I instead work on the coverage table idea mentioned in the issue?"
Yeah, I think that's a better fit for #24249.

Hi @jiwahn , I'd like to work on the coverage table. Before I start, a few quick questions to make sure I get it right:

1. Where should the table go? Should it be added to docs/source/markdown/options/mount.md, or as a separate section/file?

2. Which mount types should it cover? Should it include all current types — bind, glob, image, tmpfs, ramfs, volume, devpts, and artifact?

3. Format preference — should it be a plain markdown table, or is there a preferred style used elsewhere in the docs?

4. Scope — should the table cover every option listed in mount.md, or only the type-specific ones (skipping common ones like src/dst)?

5. eriksjolund mentioned a JSON-based generator approach in the issue thread. Should I go with a simple hand-written markdown table for now, or is the generator approach expected?

Thanks! I'll wait for your input before raising a PR.
